title: Blake Lively, Justin Baldoni Unexpectedly Coordinate In Matching Outfits At NYC Court | Hollywood News - News18
text: Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni were spotted arriving at a New York courtroom for a settlement conference in their ongoing It Ends With Us legal battle. The court-ordered settlement marked the first time the co-stars have appeared in person together since their dispute erupted in December 2024. The two arrived 33 minutes apart at the US District Court in Manhattan. Lively entered first, making a solo appearance with her legal team and looking visibly tense. Baldoni followed shortly after. Reportedly, he was accompanied by his wife, Emily and appeared relaxed. Netizens were quick to notice an unexpected detail as the co-stars seemed to be unintentionally twinning. Both wore soft pastel pink tops paired with coats and pants in shades of green. Social media users couldn’t help but comment on the coincidence, with some speculating whether the colour coordination was intentional. Wednesday’s proceeding was closed to the media and public. According to a source familiar with the matter, Lively and Baldoni spent most of the day in separate courtrooms while Magistrate Judge Sarah L Cave moved between the two legal teams. The settlement conference is standard in federal civil cases and is meant to determine whether a dispute can be resolved before heading to trial. The trial is currently scheduled for May 18. Outside the courthouse, Baldoni’s attorney, Freedman, told reporters that both camps would return Thursday for a “different matter on the docket," though he did not clarify whether the actors would be present. The Beginning Of Legal Battle The legal drama began after Lively filed a complaint with the California Civil Rights Department on December 20, 2024. In her complaint, she accused Baldoni of sexual harassment and retaliation during the filming of their 2024 romantic drama. The actress later filed a federal lawsuit on December 31 and submitted an amended complaint in February 2025, alleging a “multi-tiered plan" to damage her reputation. Baldoni countersued, but a federal judge dismissed the claim in June and formally ended it in November after a deadline to amend passed. The Success Of It Ends With Us The controversy first surfaced when fans noticed tension between the two during the film’s press tour. Despite the turmoil, It Ends With Us became a box office success, grossing over $350 million (approximately Rs 2,900 crore) worldwide. “This is a film that grossed over $300 million globally, which is an extraordinary achievement," an industry source said. “Most people in Hollywood find it pretty inexplicable why this [case] was even brought in the first place." Lively’s amended complaint seeks compensatory and punitive damages where she alleges that there was a “multi-tiered plan" by Baldoni to destroy her reputation.
